command: name="{name}"; case "$name" in backend-ruff-check) uv run --directory backend ruff check . ../scripts ../deploy/updater ;; backend-ruff-format) uv run --directory backend ruff format . ../scripts ../deploy/updater --check ;; backend-pytest) uv run --directory backend pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/integration -q -n auto --maxprocesses 4 ;; alembic-single-head) heads=$(uv run --directory backend alembic heads); printf '%s\n' "$heads"; count=$(printf '%s\n' "$heads" | awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n+0 }'); test "$count" -eq 1 ;; frontend-typecheck) cd frontend && bun run type-check ;; frontend-vitest) cd frontend && bun run test:coverage ;; frontend-prettier) cd frontend && bunx prettier --check "scripts/**/*.ts" "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "e2e/**/*.ts" ;; frontend-eslint) cd frontend && bun run lint ;; *) echo "unknown Armada task: {name}" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
